current.label: v1.1.0 (Plan 12 — audit 2026-05-12 post-V10) — custody-escrow gateway, identical surface to v1.0.0 but with the 4 [next-version] audit fixes baked in.
auditFixesIncluded: #6 — settleInvoice reverts InvalidPayInToken when relayer-supplied payInToken disagrees with inv.payIn (was silent in V10; off-chain accounting could diverge from on-chain log).
#25 — InvoicePaid emit now carries `excess` as the `fee` field instead of hardcoded 0. Indexers and downstream accounting tools see the actual protocol fee delta.
#26 — DeployV10 script logs a loud WARN when SUPPORTED_TOKENS is set but deployer != owner (the role-gated setTokenSupport call would otherwise silently no-op).
#27 — withdrawFees gains nonReentrant for consistency with every other fund-moving path. CEI already prevents today's drain; modifier blocks any future fee-on-transfer token surprise.
current.soliditySource: Same file (`src/ArcFXGatewayV10.sol`) as v1.0.0 — the contract class name didn't bump because the ABI is byte-identical. Lineage is tracked by address: V10 = `0xc91e45ff…`, V11 = `0x07BAC123…`.
current.deployNotes: Soft cutover: V10 stays on-chain to serve in-flight refund windows (7 days from each settle). New invoices route to V11; indexer dual-watches both contracts until V10's last escrow matures. Merchant must call registerMerchant on V11 separately.

deprecated_v1.0.0.label: v1.0.0 (Plan 10) — first custody-escrow deploy. Same ABI as v1.1.0; missing the four 2026-05-12 audit fixes.
deprecated_v1.0.0.reason: Superseded by v1.1.0 with audit-fix bytecode on 2026-05-13. V10 stays callable for any in-flight refund (REFUND_WINDOW = 7d, ADMIN_RECOVERY_DELAY = 7d). The indexer dual-watches both addresses through the deprecation window.
deprecated_v1.0.0.deprecationWindow: 7d refund + 7d recovery from the last settle on V10; safe to retire after 2026-05-27 at earliest if no escrows are still pending.
